justifications.durability: monkeypatch.context() is the right instrument for the defect it names: the refusal and the excepthook observer are undone with the block they were installed in, so the per-test reap and every other teardown fixture decode with the real readers. Writing the {} record into the test's own tmp_path is sound because the reap requests tmp_path and so finalizes before the tree is pruned, making the record present exactly during this test's teardown -- a sibling's tree would be pruned first. The record decodes to no pid, so it adds nothing for the reap to signal and only exercises the decode path the forgery would break. Held one point rather than full because the fragment's two-control presentation slightly muddies which mutation the declared control names, though both are recorded and both fire.
justifications.evidence: Both arms I ran reproduce independently: the node file at head is 3 passed, EXIT=0, and the delivered file with only the two scopings reverted errors at teardown with refuse(args=('{}\n',)) -- the coordinator's exact whole-suite id, reproduced from one variable. The population arms are readable and green (110 then 113 passed, both EXIT=0), and the coordinator's base/head whole-suite logs show the single added id is the one this delta repairs. Held one point because the run's own after_suite arm stops at the code head 95174af74 while the reviewed head is 12237f0cb; the gap is docs-only and the run states it, but the node fields no fresh suite arm at the reviewed head.
justifications.fit: All three gained commits carry conventional subjects with bodies (12, 10 and 7 body lines), no AI-attribution trailer on any, and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in subject, body, symbol or comment. The new test comments and docstrings name the mechanism (the process-global forgery, the reap's decode window, the tree that outlives the teardown) rather than any tracker entry, and the new local names are mechanism-named. Full marks.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The delta does exactly what the coordinator's stacked whole-suite finding required and nothing more: it ends the order dependence the stacking exposed by scoping the file's forgeries to their test bodies, and it makes the reproduction deterministic by placing the seat record where the rule has to meet it. The section's delivered mechanism is unchanged, so the section and its evidence no longer disagree. Held one point because the fragment now presents two controls in adjacent sentences -- the 'scripted control' and the 'Negative control (declared)' -- where the section's done-when names one; both fire, so the material claim holds.
justifications.scope_discipline: Exactly the two declared paths across the three gained commits, 45 insertions and 18 deletions, no conftest or runs.py change, and no shared index, sprint or plan-state mutation. The delta hardens the node's own test file and updates its own evidence fragment; it edits nothing another session owns.
